Definition: to shut up; figuratively, to surrender
BiblicalUsage: 1) to shut, close; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shut; 1a2) to close, close up; 1a3) closed up, closely joined, shut up; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be shut up; 1b2) to be shut or closed; 1c) (Piel) to shut up, deliver up; 1d) (Pual) to be shut up; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to deliver up; 1e2) to shut up, imprison
